text:
morgan: Thinking about a capacity-aware token-bucket for orgs + graceful per-key soft-throttles. Goal: keep GPU queues below 85% while letting PLG spikes through via short bursts.

riley: Love that. Do you mean refill rates change with cluster headroom?

morgan: Yes. Refill = base_refill * headroom_factor. headroom_factor = max(0.2, available_gpus/total_gpus). So when we hit saturation we reduce refill.

jyoti: How do we prevent one org from hogging bursts? Fairshare + per-key peak windows?

morgan: Plan: per-org shared bucket + per-key sub-buckets. Sub-buckets can borrow from org pool but with debt and cooldown. Also an emergency global shed when overall latency SLO breaches.

alex: Cost note: if we slow refills, throughput drops and requests queue longer — watch p99 latency and cost of retries. Maybe add short-term crediting for paid orgs.

morgan: Pseudocode:

```
# refill loop (runs every 1s)
headroom = available_gpus / total_gpus
refill_rate = base_refill * max(0.25, headroom)
for org in orgs:
  org_bucket.tokens = min(org_bucket.capacity, org_bucket.tokens + refill_rate * org.share)
  for key in org.keys:
    key.tokens = min(key.capacity, key.tokens + refill_rate * key.weight)
```

riley: Nice. What signals for 'available_gpus'? Node allocatable? GPU utilization? queue_length?

morgan: Start with schedulable GPUs (not drained) minus pods in active inference queue. Then refine with moving-average of GPU load and queue depth. Keep it conservative.

jyoti: We need metrics in Console: per-org token burn, refill rate, borrow debt, and "throttle events". Also add an alert when org borrow debt > 2x capacity for >5m.

alex: Also: default for new orgs = conservative low burst. Allow paid tiers to set higher caps.

morgan: FYI: I'll PR a draft in https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rate-limits — feedback welcome. @riley @jyoti can you sanity-check the fairness math? :eyes: 

deploy-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-rate-limits/pull/432 :tada: 

riley: Skimmed. Suggest adding a soft-eviction policy for long-running large batches that block queue.

morgan: Added a note. Thanks — will iterate.
